description: PREVIEW ONLY: export one app's data as a CSV or JSON file — keywords (the latest run's rank, demand and search depth per tracked keyword), history (daily rank per keyword between from and to) or reviews (rating, title, text, author, version between from and to). The preview shows the row count, columns and date range; confirm_action returns a download link that stays valid for 7 days and always serves the same table. 20 credits on confirm. Pro plan.

country.description: two-letter storefront (defaults to the app's first country)

from.description: history/reviews: first day YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to the plan's API window / the last 90 days)

name: export_data
